label: Major bank low-doc
description: Big-four and second-tier bank asset finance divisions. Sharpest rates, tightest policy. This is the policy AssetMX qualifies against by default.

lowDoc.minDeposit: None for property owners; typically 10 to 20% otherwise, or a shorter term
lowDoc.creditFileRequirement: Clean: no defaults, no judgments, no recent arrears on directors or the business
lowDoc.typicalTurnaround: Same business day conditional approval when fully in policy

notes: Asset must be primarily business use and on the standard asset list (vehicles, trucks, yellow goods, common trade equipment).
Above the no-financials cap, expect a request for the latest financial statements or BAS.
Non-property-owning applicants usually need a deposit or stronger bank statement conduct.
